name: Host pod is stopped
note: A node drain or rollout stops a host pod running many agents.

steps.label: SIGTERM, grace 600 s
steps.say: Host pods set a long termination grace period and a PodDisruptionBudget, which StatefulSets support.

steps.label: Draining{agents}
steps.say: The controller stops sending new work here and holds messages in the outbox.

steps.label: wait for each turn to end
steps.say: Agents finish their current turn instead of being cut off mid-edit.

steps.label: Stop hook
steps.say: The Stop hook marks a turn boundary, a safe point to end the CLI.

steps.label: Released{agent → session_id}
steps.say: Each agent's session id is saved for resume.

steps.label: replacement pod, same volume
steps.say: The StatefulSet brings the pod back with the same identity and volume.

steps.label: Spawn{resume} for agents that were awake
steps.say: Agents that were awake before come back. Sleeping agents stay asleep.
